page_title: ACM 4-0 VEN | AC Milan v Venezia 14/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' A substitution has been made. Francesco Zampano is replaced by Franco Carboni (Venezia).
89' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
88' AC Milan earn a corner.
88' Kevin Zeroli (AC Milan) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and AC Milan will take a corner.
87' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Noah Okafor (AC Milan) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Jesse Joronen easily catches the ball.
85' Magnus Kofod Andersen (Venezia) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
85' Davide Di Marco blows his whistle for a foul after Noah Okafor (AC Milan) hacks down one of his opponents. It's a free kick to Venezia, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
83' Michael Svoboda (Venezia) sends a long ball forward to John Yeboah, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
79' That's the end of the game for Joel Pohjanpalo, who is replaced by Antonio Raimondo (Venezia).
79' Substitution. Gianluca Busio makes way for Magnus Kofod Andersen (Venezia).
79' Paulo Fonseca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kevin Zeroli (AC Milan) replacing Youssouf Fofana.
79' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Christian Pulisic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).
77' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

77' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes behind for a corner. AC Milan will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yunus Musah (AC Milan) comes onto the pitch for Tammy Abraham.
73' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) seems to have forgotten that he has already received a yellow card as he is surprised when the referee shows him a second one!
73' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Venezia players look gutted.
72' The Venezia players halt their celebrations as referee Davide Di Marco makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
71' Goal! Francesco Zampano (Venezia) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 4:1.
67' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
64' Here comes a substitution. Gaetano Oristanio is given a rest as he is replaced by John Yeboah (Venezia).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Issa Doumbia (Venezia) replaces Alfred Duncan.
64' Paulo Fonseca prepares a substitution. Rafael Leao is replaced by Alvaro Morata (AC Milan).
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Noah Okafor (AC Milan) for Tijjani Reijnders.
60' A player from AC Milan pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Venezia have a free kick.
59' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
56' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Rafael Leao, but Jesse Joronen displays great awareness to stop him.
55' Gianluca Busio races towards the box before laying off to Alfred Duncan (Venezia), who picks it up but blazes a shot well over the bar from the edge of the box.
54' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
53' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends the corner into the box, but Jesse Joronen intercepts it and averts the threat.
52' The corner kick from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. AC Milan win a corner.
52' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.

51' Jay Idzes (Venezia) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Davide Di Marco blows his whistle for an infringement. AC Milan have been awarded a free kick.
50' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Gianluca Busio (Venezia).
49' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Jesse Joronen is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
47' Antonio Candela (Venezia) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
45' Referee Davide Di Marco sees the trip by Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Venezia will take a free kick.
42' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Mike Maignan makes a save.
42' Davide Di Marco interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan).
40' The game is interrupted now, Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
39' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Davide Di Marco didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
38' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) whips in a cross from the corner, but Jesse Joronen is well positioned and punches the ball away.
37' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Now AC Milan have a corner.
35' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:3. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 5:0.
31' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
29' 4 - 0 Goal! Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Jesse Joronen to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
29' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) is going to take the penalty!
28' Joel Schingtienne (Venezia) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
28' The AC Milan players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
28' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for AC Milan! Let's see what he decides.
26' PENALTY APPEAL after Rafael Leao (AC Milan) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
25' 3 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Jesse Joronen no chance!
25' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
24' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' Jesse Joronen (Venezia) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. No point in arguing there. AC Milan will take a penalty kick.

23' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Jesse Joronen shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
22' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) attempts to feed Emerson Royal with a chip pass, but Jesse Joronen reacts well and comes off his line to intercept.

21' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Davide Di Marco with no other option than to blow for a foul.
16' 2 - 0 Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) rose high above the defence to head the ball over the goalkeeper and inside the net.
16' There's an opportunity for Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

16' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
15' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post.
12' Ooh that was close! Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) collects a pass and runs with pace goalwards before unleashing a great drive from the edge of the box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
12' Chance! Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
11' That's unlucky! Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
6' Mike Maignan (AC Milan) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
6' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) and Gianluca Busio attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
5' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) finds his teammate inside the box with a sweet pass. However, Antonio Candela wasn't able to finish and lost the ball.
4' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

2' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Rafael Leao, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Theo Hernandez (AC Milan), who beats Jesse Joronen with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
1' The first half has started.
Venezia will kick-off.
Davide Di Marco will supervise the game today.
